name: The Wildwatch
detailed_description:
About This Game

Step into a tower defense experience from a first-person perspective, where you stand at the tower and watch it attack enemies automatically. Learn core mechanics; earning gold, upgrading stats, and surviving waves.

Gameplay

Enemies march toward your central tower in relentless waves. You don’t place turrets, you simply observe as your tower fires on its own. Your role is to strategize through the upgrade menu between waves, choosing which stats to boost for your next run.

Upgrades & Meta Progression

Earn Gold after each trial and spend it in the meta-upgrade menu to permanently raise your tower’s Attack, Defense, or Support stats. Each run builds on the last, so even if you fall before the final wave, you return stronger and more prepared.

Stylized Visuals

Immerse yourself in a vibrant world featuring semi-realistic grass swaying in the wind, and dynamic lighting. The game’s visual style strikes a balance between realism and artistry, ensuring you stay focused on strategic decisions without feeling distracted.

3–4 Hours of Gameplay

Balanced so that dedicated players can complete the game in about three to four hours, you’ll experience escalating difficulty and meaningful progression without any filler. Experiment with different upgrade paths and see how far you can push your tower’s capabilities.

short_description: Experience a first-person tower defense: stand beside a self-firing tower, earn Gold to upgrade Attack, Defense, and Support stats, and survive waves of Fire Piglets and more. Enjoy vibrant visuals and engaging gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Quad core 3Ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 capable GPU with 1GB VRAM - GeForce GTX 750 Ti, Radeon R7 360 or Intel UHD Graphics 730
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11, 10
  • Processor: Quad core 4Ghz+ from 2020 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 capable GPU with 4 GB VRAM - GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, Radeon RX 570, Intel Arc
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
